correctness.rationale: The proof combines exact partition removal identities, the fixed-shift Hardy--Ramanujan ratio 1-p(n-h)/p(n)=pi*h/sqrt(6n)+O(n^-1), the O(n^-1) probability of two distinct short-cycle count defects from mixed finite differences, and effective bounded-degree Hanf locality. The long-cycle vertex type is saturated except with exp(-Omega(sqrt n)) probability. This yields an explicit integer M_phi and O_phi(n^-1) error. Absence-of-m-cycle FO sentences realize every positive integer coefficient; complements realize negatives. Finite checker reproduced 527 arithmetic checks, but is not a proof of the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The existing unlabelled-TOOB qualitative 0-1 law leaves open quantitative convergence rates and the arithmetic set of all leading errors. This complete all-sentence first-correction theorem supplies an effective algorithm, a sharp signed integer spectrum and an automatic improved O(n^-1) class, under a natural model of uniform isomorphism-class sampling. It is not a routine renaming of the qualitative limit law.
